definitions.explanation: A word or set of words by which a person or thing is known.

examples.japanese: お{名前|なまえ}は{何|なん}ですか。
{名前|なまえ}を{書|か}いてください。

notes:
{名前|なまえ} means name.

JAPANESE NAMES:
In Japanese, family name comes before given name.

RELATED:
- {名字|みょうじ}: surname, family name
- {下の名前|したのなまえ}: first name, given name

COMPOUNDS:
- {名札|なふだ}: name tag
- {名刺|めいし}: business card
